raw_response:
This plot is small, only 0.12 hectares, and it is rented land so I do not want to spend too much cash on it. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, but with no FISP coupon for this rented plot and the Lower Shire being dry and risky with floods, I will keep it simple. I will use my own saved seed and put some manure from my goats, and weed it myself with my wife and older children. Last year the rains were uneven here in Chikwawa, so I will not borrow money for chemical fertilizer on land that is not mine.
